decision: Continue the six deployed v51 assets unchanged. Treat BRENTOIL and MU as separately ranked report-only candidates, not as approved live additions. BRENTOIL has exact live execution priors and top-ten liquidity but no validated new-strategy edge. MU has top-ten liquidity but unresolved source-transport parity and no live lifecycle economics.
falsifier: Any candidate leaves the pipeline if fresh venue data loses top-ten liquidity, exact fees or account reconciliation fail, prospective evidence becomes technically unresolved, or after-cost forward lifecycles are negative and fragile. A candidate advances only after source-native, both-side, resolved evidence survives costs and largest-winner sensitivity.

recommendation.recommendation: Keep the six-asset v51 live portfolio unchanged while operating BRENTOIL and MU as explicit report-only candidate lanes.
recommendation.why_now: The user requested four crypto and four non-crypto assets and correctly identified that BRENTOIL already has live-canary data. The rolling digest previously omitted that evidence.
evidence_reviewed: fresh v51 checkpoint and rolling improvement digest
BRENTOIL live-canary reconciliation and oil-shock observer
MU candle, signal, and transport-parity reports
recommendation.observed_problem_or_opportunity: BRENTOIL supplies a liquid oil diversification lane with empirical execution priors; MU supplies a liquid semiconductor lane, but neither has validated source-native forward edge for live deployment.
recommendation.applicable_market_regime: The ranking is evidence-maturity based and is not a claim that current price regime favors either candidate. Route economics must be evaluated within their actual future regimes.
alternatives_considered: reuse MU archive economics under the live REST source
recommendation.expected_upside: Preserves the possibility of higher opportunity cadence and cross-asset diversification without contaminating live capital with unvalidated route economics.
recommendation.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Sparse data can delay decisions or create outlier dependence; candidate liquidity can change; live-source behavior may diverge from research; correlations during macro shocks are unknown.
recommendation.validation_completed: Exact identity, top-ten liquidity, current observer freshness, report-only authority, source hashes, BRENTOIL canary fills/costs, and MU source mismatches are reconciled.
recommendation.validation_still_required: Resolved source-native lifecycles, both directions, actual candidate-route friction, non-adjacent regimes, largest-winner sensitivity, correlation/co-trigger stress, and an untouched forward window.
recommendation.success_metrics: Positive after-cost candidate net and PF above one; positive ex-largest net; technically resolved paths; both-side or explicitly predeclared side evidence; stable non-adjacent windows; acceptable portfolio co-trigger stress.
recommendation.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Observer identity, data-path, fee, or risk-path mismatch; loss of liquidity; negative robust forward evidence; or portfolio stress exceeding a separately approved limit rejects or defers the candidate.
recommendation.confidence_level: high on current evidence classification and liquidity; low on candidate profitability

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Collect the next attributable source-native SPCX long lifecycle while continuing BRENTOIL and MU observers; update the ranking immediately if a candidate produces a resolved lifecycle first.
